desc: Checks available disk space and cleans temporary files if free space falls below a specified threshold.

params.name: threshold_gb
params.desc: Disk space threshold in gigabytes; if free space is below this value, temp files will be cleaned.

params.name: dry_run
params.desc: When true, only report what would be cleaned without actually deleting files.

params.name: temp_dir
params.desc: Path to the temporary directory to clean; defaults to the system temp folder.
